summary: Reject private changelog modules in public web builds when the registry is reached through a symbolic link.

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup migration required.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes; remove private imports before retrying a rejected public build.

compatibility.detail: Public web builds reject private changelog graph imports through either the configured directory or its native real filesystem path, including virtual and Vite filesystem module IDs. Both the private directory and a symlinked registry file target directory stay protected. Private builds and runtime protocols are unchanged.
